title: Shiraishi An — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: A few weeks before An's birthday
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ugh! What should I do?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You've been stuck for a while, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean c'mon, MEIKO said she'd make me any cake I want! Who wouldn't be stuck?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There's still time until your birthday, so take your time deciding.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not making up my mind yet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's understandable that you'd be spoiled for choice since there are so many varieties of cake.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes! Exactly!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I could go classic with a strawberry shortcake, but then I'd be missing out on chocolate...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Personally, I like cakes with a lot of fruit.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hmm... As for me, I'd choose something that's tea-flavored and less sweet.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're right...! That sounds really good too...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh no, that means even more options to consider! I'm never gonna decide!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you really struggling over something like this?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: C'mon, how many birthday cakes do you get in a year?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you have any recommendations, Akito?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna hear your advice too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, I'm not the expert you're making me out to be.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That being said, there was that one pretty good cake.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? What was it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It was mint chocolate, and they got the balance of those two flavors just right. It was kinda hard to put my fork down.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It even had this mint-green cream filling that looked kinda summery, so it'd be a good choice for this time of year.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mint chocolate...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've decided, MEIKO! I'd like a mint chocolate cake for my birthday!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, got it. I hope you're looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? You made up your mind based on just that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Since it's you, I assumed you were just gonna suggest pancakes or cheesecake. But you threw me a curveball, and now I'm curious.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's great that Shiraishi made up her mind, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, it is.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, by the way, An.
Is there anything you want to do on your birthday?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anything I want to do?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. If there is, I was thinking we could do it together as a way to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...! Thank you, that means a lot!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, what do I want to do...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh! There is just one thing.
You see, I...
An's birthday
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, we're all set up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Great!
Now we can start whenever.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't believe you wanted to put on a street performance for your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: For one thing, don't you do this all the time? Why now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because I love singing, duh!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But also, there've hardly been any times that all four of us have done this together, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Come to think of it, we often practice in the park, but I suppose you're right about actual street performances.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright then, let's sing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Oh, is that a street performance? Wow, those kids must be high schoolers!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Hold the phone, they're good! Real good!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Hey, let's stop and watch for a bit! These kids are amazing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yes... More and more people are stopping to watch.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The street's starting to feel like a live house... I love this sensation.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And today, we're all together. It's gonna be even more fun than usual...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, I had a blast!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for doing this with me, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Don't mention it. I really enjoyed it too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So did I, and our audience very much seemed to as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wouldn't mind doing this sorta thing again sometime.
An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? I know that voice...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haruka?! What are you doing here?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, it's just a coincidence! Right, everyone?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Everyone”?
An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?! What's happening?!
